SLOT gestureSlots INSERT TEMPLATE swipes{
	id: swipeEdgeForSelection
	distance: 0.5 
	direction: Values.accessibilityRightHanded ?Qt.point(1, 1): Qt.point(-1,1)

	releaseRequired: false
	conditionName :selectionOr
	condition: (documentViewTools.activeTool === "selection")
	areas: Values.accessibilityRightHanded ?Qt.rect(0, toolbar.height/3, touchArea.edgeSize, toolbar.height/3): Qt.rect(touchArea.width, toolbar.height/3, -touchArea.edgeSize, toolbar.height/3)
	fingers:1
	action:{
			if (!selectionOr){toolbar.selectSelection();}
			else {toolbar.selectPen("primary");}}
}
END SLOT
